description: Twenty queries whose correct answer is not in dispute. This is a tripwire, not a benchmark: it exists so that a bad change to fusion weights, tokenisation or the graph fails CI instead of shipping. Nothing here is a claim about retrieval quality in general.

fields.expect_slug: a problem that must appear in the top-k; chosen because it is the canonical statement of the technique described
fields.expect_family_contains: case-insensitive substring the chosen ladder's family name or tags should contain; null where no single family is obviously correct
fields.phrasing: literal = uses the standard jargon; oblique = describes the technique without naming it (the case this project exists for)
